description:
The story of Athanasia, forsaken princess of the Obelian Empire, ends with her execution at the hands of her own father—or does it? Her tragic tale is the plot of the novel The Lovely Princess. But now, a modern woman who read the book has just woken up as baby Athanasia herself, filled with her own memories and knowledge of the story she’s stuck in! Determined to survive her doomed fate, infant Athanasia embarks on this new life with a plan: avoid attention and hoard valuables to fund her escape. When her plan goes awry, she suddenly needs to charm her way into the good graces of her father, the beautiful tyrant emperor, so he doesn’t kill her again! 

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

*Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.*

unknown.title: Her tale of Shim Chong - Loin des yeux

description:
Based on a Korean folktale, two very different women find themselves making the same wish - to leave this world behind. One is Shim Chong, a young beggar living off the kindness of others to support herself and her blind father. The other is the bride-to-be of old Chancellor Jang, sold off to him for the sake of her family. When Shim Chong rescues this new bride from the river, their relationship triggers both love and hidden intentions. But will these two women be able to find their way forth in a world that favors men?

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Includes seven extra chapters.*

Hui-Su’s world revolves around Chan-Young, his best friend and secret crush. He doesn’t mind cheering Chan-Yeong from the sidelines or listening to all his girl problems. He doesn’t care if people only know him as “Chan-Yeong’s friend.” Then one day, Hui-Su starts hearing his name everywhere. On the bus, in the halls, during lunch… Turns out, there’s a rumor going around school (Got a love problem? Find Hui-Su in Class 2 and he’ll tell you what to do!) and with that, Hui-Su suddenly finds himself the center of attention. But how could he give anyone advice? He doesn’t even know what to do about his own crush!

(Source: Lezhin, edited)

title: Sign
description:
There are a few unusual things about Cafe Goyo. Number one, their coffee sucks. Number two, their customers never order off the menu. And number three, Yohan, the cafe manager, is deaf. So when Soohwa joins as a part-timer, though he is not expected to learn how to make good coffee, he is asked to expand his sign language vocabulary beyond the words, “higher,” “pay,” and “please.” But when Yohan offers to give him private lessons, Soohwa is reluctant. Not because he doesn’t want to study, but because he has a “hard” time around Yohan. Like, literally. He gets hard. Whenever he hears Yohan’s deep, sexy voice. 

(Source: Lezhin)

title: Jazz for Two
description:
Taeyi hears a familiar melody fill the empty halls and makes his way to the old music room. He knows his brother is dead, but he can’t help but hope, maybe, just maybe...it’s his brother playing his favorite song. When he slams open the door, however, he finds Seheon, the new transfer student, at the piano. Disappointment comes crashing down and Taeyi can’t control his anger. How dare Seheon play his brother’s song? How dare he smile? How dare he say he loves jazz? “If I ever catch you playing the piano again...that’ll be the end of you.” And with that begins their story, as unpredictable and visceral as jazz.

(Source: Lezhin US)

So when Jaime moves to a new neighborhood, Percy makes sure to follow the only thing he has left in the world... Only Jaime doesn’t know who Percy is. The two soon learn that their lives are even more intertwined than either ever knew. Along the way, they meet Jessica, the erotic thriller novelist with three cats, and Noland, a former colleague of Jaime’s who apparently dropped out. And after meeting Jessica’s cats, Percy learns he has a special gift: he speaks Yumyum, the language of Yummies (aka hoomans).

(Source: Lezhin US)

title: Hell & High Water
description:
When homicide detective Dexter J. Daley’s testimony helps send his partner away for murder, the consequences—and the media frenzy—aren’t far behind. He soon finds himself sans boyfriend, sans friends, and, after an unpleasant encounter in a parking garage after the trial, he’s lucky he doesn’t find himself sans teeth. Dex fears he’ll get transferred from the Human Police Force’s Sixth Precinct, or worse, get dismissed. Instead, his adoptive father—a sergeant at the Therian-Human Intelligence Recon Defense Squadron, otherwise known as the THIRDS—pulls a few strings, and Dex gets recruited as a Defense Agent. 

Dex is determined to get his life back on track and eager to get started in his new job. But his first meeting with Team Leader Sloane Brodie, who also happens to be his new jaguar Therian partner, turns disastrous. When the team is called to investigate the murders of three Humanitherian activists, it soon becomes clear to Dex that getting his partner and the rest of the tightknit team to accept him will be a lot harder than catching the killer—and every bit as dangerous. 

(Source: Dreamspinner Press)

Can Dam and Wu-Yeo find a way to remove the bead from Dam’s body before it’s too late? And will Dam ever find love, especially when her unusual circumstances restrict her dating options?

description:

title: House of Desire
description:
Are we bound by the fate of our blood? Or do we possess it within ourselves to change our destiny? Growing up between families as a child, Dora Blunt is elated when she finally finds a place to call home in the arms of her distant aunt, Grace Blunt. Grace, having forfeit custody of her son Jack after she was deemed unfit to be a mother, views Dora as a way to correct the mistakes of her past - a gift from the heavens themselves. The two grow closer and closer, and it seems to Dora that she finally has found the place she belongs. But when Jack returns to Grace’s care, Dora finds herself experiencing mixed emotions: jealousy tinged with curiosity, joy entangled with fear, and perhaps most intensely of all, a desire to be wanted. As she feels herself being pushed back into the familiar shadows of neglect, Dora must do whatever it takes to gain control of her path in life and stay in the light. 

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: Includes 3 extra chapters.*

title: CHA CHA On The Bridge
description:
To battle the alarming suicide rate, the government initiates a suicide prevention program using AI robots. CHA-88K, a humanoid robot, is placed on Mapo Bridge, the nation's highest suicide spot. "Cha Cha" receives a lot of attention in the beginning, but is eventually considered a failure and funding for the programs stops. However, Cha Cha continues to watch over the bridge. Due to her ability to infinitely synchronize with other AI robots, she can observe the private lives of many humans. Cha Cha despairs over what she sees in human society and develops something similar to depression and lethargy. Ai, CEO of White Island Nursing Home, purchases the decrepit Cha Cha from the government, brings her to the nursing home, shakes her out of her stupor, and ultimately convinces her to become Earth's next "Mother." in a futuristic society where people have become cold and calculating machines and AI robots take over many services once performed by human beings, Cha Cha, Ai, and the other AI robots force us to examine what it means to be human.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

title: Tell Me It's Real
description:
Do you believe in love at first sight? 

Paul Auster doesn't. Paul doesn't believe in much at all. He’s thirty, slightly overweight, and his best features are his acerbic wit and the color commentary he provides as life passes him by. He works a dead-end job in a soul-sucking cubicle, and his closest friends are a quasibipolar drag queen named Helena Handbasket and a two-legged dog named Wheels. Enter Vince Taylor. Vince is everything Paul isn’t: hot, sexy, and confident. And for some reason, Vince pursues Paul relentlessly. Vince must be messing with him, because there is no way Vince could want someone like Paul. But when Paul hits Vince with his car—in a completely unintentional if-he-died-it'd-only-be-manslaughter kind of way—he's forced to see Vince in a whole new light. The only thing stopping Paul from believing in Vince is himself—and that is one obstacle Paul can’t quite seem to overcome. But when tragedy strikes Vince's family, Paul must put aside any notions he has about himself and stand next to the man who thinks he's perfect the way he is.

(Source: Dream Spinner)

title: Take Care of My Housekeeper
description:
When college student Ban Chan hits his wealthy underclassman Doyun's car with his motorcycle and runs off without taking responsibility, Doyun tracks him down and informs him that he owes him 10 million won in damages. Broke, in debt and unable to escape the consequences of his hit-and-run, Ban Chan loses his girlfriend and his job and ends up working as Doyun's temporary housekeeper. As the two young men get to know each other better, Ban Chan learns that Doyun's family is rather dysfunctional. He was abused by his brother for being gay, and he's being stalked by his obsessed step-sister who refuses to believe it and has convinced herself that he will one day marry her. To get rid of her, Doyun offers to reduce Ban Chan's debt if he pretends to be his lover, and he agrees. But what happens when this fake couple develops real feelings? 

*Note: Includes an extra.*

description:
Kang Pado is a boy who accompanies his father on their countryside farm; raising cattle, fruits, and vegetables for a living. At the same time, he is studying at the not-so-nearby high school which, traveled by land, is 10km away. However, Pado’s father unwittingly mentions to him a shortcut using the river, shortening the distance to only 3km. Being an obedient kid, he takes his father’s advice and swims every day back and forth to the school whenever he has classes. 

However, circumstances occur when, due to a lack of students in their high school, the administration shuts it down, leaving Kang Pado no choice but to go to Seoul, where his sister lives. There he will continue his high school studies and deal with what Seoul High School Life has to offer! 

*Note: Winner of the SPP 2018 Webtoon Awards.*

title: Lady Cinderella
description:
After her mother's death, Elladis (Ella) had fallen from her father's favor and was reduced to being a maid under the abuse of her stepmother and sisters. But her stepmother wasn't satisfied to treat Ella as her maid, so she forced her to marry a gambler-crazy Viscount. The only pleasure for Ella, who lives a difficult life, was the country's hero, Archduke Wellington. She goes through each day memorizing anything about Archduke Wellington.

The Viscount, who is her husband only in name, sells Ella to pay his gambling debts. However, Ella, who runs away with the intention of dying, somehow returns to the age of 18 after a desperate wish. The opportunity came once again like a miracle! 

She decided not to live the way she used to until she inherited her mother's legacy and chose to entrust herself to Archduke Wellington. 

What will be the conclusion of Ella's bold choice, who proposes a contractual engagement to Archduke Wellington using the information she knows from her previous life as bait? 

(Source: Kakao, translated and edited)

description: In 1888, a young client, Mary Morstan, arrives at Holmes's and asks him for help. Watson falls under the spell of the young woman who explains her problem: her father, a navigator in the Indies, died about ten years earlier. However, she has been receiving, for six years, and on a regular basis, pearls of great value. And that same day she receives a letter. An anonymous person asks her to come to an appointment. Holmes agrees to help her and, supported by Watson, accompanies Mary to the said appointment. They discover on the spot that the anonymous person is the son of a former friend and colleague of Captain Morstan. The latter reveals that their fathers had discovered a treasure of five hundred thousand pounds, but that neither the treasure nor the jewels were shared with Morstan's daughter. The man finally explains that his brother discovered the chest yesterday, hidden in their house. But when they arrive at the scene, they find the brother dead and the chest missing. Holmes and Watson then begin a dangerous journey that will lead them to a crazy chase on the Thames...

title: Judge Kyle
description:
A decision-making judge, who had been obsessed with unsolved cases to catch the serial killer who disappeared in 16 years, eventually faced a grand conspiracy to control the species using disease.

The future has brought a world where humans conquer and completely wipe out diseases. As diseases disappear the life span of humans increase but crime rates rise. To lower crime rates, the government injects diseases into the guilty criminal. The criminal will then suffer from the disease until the sentencing has been completed. Once the punishment is finished the cure is injected to the criminal. The only way to reduce the sentencing is to either give a tip on another crime or turn yourself in for the crime.

Kyle is judge and executioner. He can make an arrest and sentence the offender at the scene of the crime with his revolver that contains disease bullets. He is very tough on crime. While pursuing a criminal, Kyle runs into his first love, Mariel, who disappeared 16 years ago. She was kidnapped by the notorious criminal, Handyman. Through the sacrifice of her friend, Amy, Mariel was able to escape Handyman. With the encouragement of Humble, Amy's father, Mariel becomes a special agent to fight against criminals like Handyman. Humble injects Mariel with the 'Peter Pan Syndrome', allowing her to easily capture criminals like Handyman. But Humble is unaware of the hidden secret of the Peter Pan Syndrome injection – its healing powers.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=4148611), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/53479600)

title: Tarantella
description:
*Note: This is a promotional oneshot.*  
[Promotional Webtoon](https://page.kakao.com/home/50631006)

"Stamp these divorce papers, please."

After five years of marriage, my husband ended it with one envelope.

I can't believe I was chased out by his nine-tailed fox-like lover. 

"How dare you! You can't do this to me!"

In a burst of anger, I opened my eyes and returned to the time before Ophelia's engagement, the spring when I was 18 years old. 

My God-given second chance. I'll make a different choice this time. A dress instead of a knight's uniform, jewellery instead of swords!

Eckhardt Beyard, this time it's my turn. Take a taste of your own medicine for once. 

A courageous female knight is born again as a beautiful lady!

description:
A woman named Maria lives under the absolute control of a powerful man. Forced to wear a collar around her neck like a pet, she must obey his every command to please him.

Trapped in a luxurious but suffocating cage of obedience, Maria's life is filled with secrets, danger, and twisted desires. As she navigates her dark reality, hidden truths about her past and the man who owns her begin to surface.

A mature psychological thriller full of obsession, control, and suspense.

description:
This webtoon depicts the events that happened during the year off between Age of Youth 1 and 2 drama. The original was a coming-of-age housemate drama showing how university students from all different backgrounds coped with the various struggles and relationships in their lives.   
In the second season, the girls return a year later to their sharehouse Belle Epoque. This webtoon is a project to help connect the two seasons, filling in fans on what happened in between. The webtoon’s main character will be Kang Yina a.k.a Kang Unnie. She left Belle Epoque in pursuit of her own entrepreneurial dreams so she’s no longer a part of the second, a little bit of which was shown in Season 2. But the webtoon will show her journey and relationships with the girls as she finds her own niche. There is one new character introduced in the webtoon as well, named Seunghyun.  
(Source: Drama Beans)

[How a girl saves herself in the world]

The earth collapsed and the 'land' disappeared, but unfortunately, humanity was not extinct.  
This is because the military company "North" created a so-called "ark" and burned people-accurate labor forces- to endure a series of disasters.  
The surviving people were exploited by labor to suit North's taste, and lived a rough life in it.  
A life in which dozens of people are raped and killed in a lump of bread and hundreds of people lay down in one room...  
The place where the ark reached was hell, not paradise.

Kim is a 15-year-old girl born in Ark and living in Ark.  
Mom dies, and she doesn't know who she is. What Kim was given is an old photo, an off electronic watch, and a 'special ability'.

Like his mother, who was a diver, one day when Kim was making a living as a diver, suddenly,  
There is an opportunity to save the fate of Arkju and his future.

title: Blinker
description:
A young man suffering from nightmares in where he kills people finds out that the dreams are actually visions and that he is the only one who can save a group of superpowered people from being hunted down like dogs.

Blinkers are a special lot with special abilities who if they happen to kill each other, can absorb the energy and upgrade their own abilities. This made it quite common for them to kill each other to further enhance their abilities, leading to their own kind hiding their identities and living alone like dogs. Hyun-gun, a nomad, has also lived in the dark for that same reason. However, he often suffers from nightmares where in each one he kills someone he doesn’t even know. Suffering these delusions more and more, he seeks medical advice from a psychiatrist he ran into a year ago. She was the only person willing to help in an age when superpowers created mistrust for one another.

Then one day, Hyun-gun finds out that the nightmares are actually real events with real people being killed and his ability is to see these things, making them not dreams. As it turns out, a young woman named Winna created a device that could absorb the energy of those with super-powers, and has been manipulating Blinkers to kill each other in order to collect their energy. Winna urges Hyun-gun to cooperate, but as he refuses to do so, she sends men with super-powers to kill his friend Hyun-jae. Now those being pursued turn to Hyun-gun for help, hoping that his ability to read the minds of other Blinkers will help stop Winna’s plans to absorb them.

title: Hero's Variable
description:
The superhero world isn’t what it seems for one aspiring hero.

Lee Byeonsu, dreams of becoming a superhero and moves from his small island home to Seoul. On the day he arrives, he comes across his superhero role model, Invincible Man battling a villain and even intervenes. The fight is broadcasted live as Byeonsu vanquishes the villain with his superhero like powers but instead of feeling elated Byeonsu is left confused.

He is then contacted by Kang Cheol, legendary hero and the President of the Superhero Alliance Group. Cheol offers to make Byeonsu a hero – Invincible Man’s sidekick to be exact. Byeonsu accepts but soon realizes that everything is smoke and mirrors. The Superhero Alliance Group has been staging violent combats in and around Seoul as a strategy to prevent real violence and keep Seoul peaceful.

Byeonsu begins his sidekick training and in the process meets aspiring heroes and villains. He finally makes his debut as the ‘Peace ONE.’

Things go well for Byeonsu until the accident. During a staged fight, Byeonsu saves the villain and there is an uproar over the rescue. The Superhero Alliance Group makes the decision to turn Byeonsu into a villain and he quietly disappears from the public.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/59591538), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=8533147)

description:
In the spring of 20 years old, Han Song-i, an ordinary college student who wants to meet a man of fate and fall in love. The moment she step into the shower room refreshed after exercising at the newly opened gym, a man comes out of the sauna room with his naked body… 'Huh? That's Hwang Jewang (the Emperor King)?!'

Hwang Jewang, the youngest professor at Hankuk University, is living a perfect life as his name suggests.  
One day, he falls into a huge mess for the first time in his life because of Han Song-yi, who he meets naked in the shower room... The self-illuminating professor and her quirky charms The sweet and salty campus scandal!

title: Sumyeongsa
description:
During the Joseun Dynasty, people in the Hamkyung province were suffering from severe poverty and hunger. Rumors spread that someone in the woods was buying people's "life thread". It sounded like a terrible joke, but those who were paid for their life thread actually died before their time.

Sul-Li, a fisherman's daughter, is worried about her little brother because all the men in her family died young while at sea. Then she hears the rumor of the "life-threader".

"If one can buy a life thread, then one can also sell it, right?"

Ha-Wol is the one who buys 'life-threads' for fragile Dong-I, the Taoist fairy who became human. Ha-Wol sees Sul-Li and realizes Sul-Li's body could save Dong-I for good. So Ha-Wol makes Sul-Li an offer she cannot refuse…

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

*Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.*

title: To the East
description:
"In a future where the light of a once brilliant civilization has faded to dust, four gunmen are heading east."
A future where civilization has collapsed for unknown reasons. Living in the last human city ruled by Big Boss, they live a hellish existence in the land of death beyond the wall to the east. But one day, a sealed door to the east opens, and a man named John Doe appears, shouting! "To the east!" Rumors spread that John Doe came from the legendary eastern paradise, and the protagonist, Bango, sets out across the wall to find it. The east beyond the wall is a land of death swarming with zombies. Bango advances east in search of clues to the existence of paradise, approaching John Doe, the true identity of paradise, and the secret of humanity's destruction. Will he find hope there?


**Original Webtoon:**  
[Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EB%8F%99%EC%AA%BD%EC%9C%BC%EB%A1%9C/1350), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/64411941)

title: Reply Prime Minister!
description:
[Original Webtoon](https://ridibooks.com/books/847004176)

The setting is the Houses of Parliament in a fictional London. Noel, a young politician and first-term Member of the House of Commons for the ruling party, receives a text message one day from Helen, the party leader, inviting him to attend a meeting at the Prime Minister 's residence. After the meeting, Noel reunites with Thomas Cardinal, the opposition leader and his Eton alumnus, through Helen's arrangement. They have dinner together, and somehow end up spending the night together. The next morning, Noel leaves Cardinal's house to get the newspaper only to be surrounded by reporters, where he learns that Helen announced her intention to resign the previous night and nominated him as the candidate for Prime Minister. Thus, having entered the Prime Minister's residence, Noel embarks on the path of becoming the new, young leader of the ruling party…

Tiana tries to push him away afraid he will abuse her. However affection towards him seem to be stronger. Will addiction turn into something more? Or after discovering the truth she will turn her back to him?

(Source: Webtoons)

title: Brave (Svetlana Chmakova)
description:
In his daydreams, Jensen is the biggest hero that ever was, saving the world and his friends on a daily basis. But his middle school reality is VERY different - math is hard, getting along with friends is hard...Even finding a partner for the class project is a big problem when you always get picked last. And the pressure's on even more once the school newspaper's dynamic duo, Jenny and Akilah, draw Jensen into the whirlwind of school news, social experiment projects, and behind-the-scenes club drama. Jensen's always played the middle school game one level at a time, but suddenly, someone's cranked up the difficulty setting. Will those daring daydreams of his finally work in his favor, or will he have to find real solutions to his real life problems?

The charming world of Berrybrook Middle School gets a little bigger in this highly anticipated follow up to Svetlana Chmakova's award winning Awkward with a story about a boy who learns his own way of being Brave!

description:
The VKs ― Mal, Evie, Jay and Carlos ― have been invited to attend Auradon Prep! But they have a sneaky plan to steal the fairy godmother’s wand to rescue their parents from exile and let chaos reign over the people of the United States of Auradon. As the VKs tour the campus, they are introduced to the children of Disney's most famous heroes ― Ben, Audrey, Jane and Chad. After a spirited but ultimately fruitless attempt at stealing the wand, they are forced to continue their new double lives in the academy while they work together to concoct a new evil scheme.

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: World of Hartz
description:
Han has always had trouble relating to women, but when he plays a new game called World of Hartz he finds himself involved in a totally immersive gaming experience that turns him into an online hero and an instant hit with all the virtual ladies. His growing reputation as the best Hartz player leads to a job offer from the game developer. Once inside, Han finds out that there is a lot more going on than fun, games, and chasing girls. A web of power, politics, and international conspiracies plus a game so addictive that it destroys lives add up to the ultimate challenge for Han as he fights to save his friends and his world.
Source: Tokyopop

title: Wimp
description:
What happens when people from parallel universes meet? Wimp is a story centered around someone who meets the parallel versions of himself- whether dead or alive. Follow Mek and Meb as they try to fill the shoes of their predecessor, Med, in the world where music is looked down upon. How will the late Med's friends view Mek and Meb? Can they change the world? Do they even want to? The story only gets more interesting from there.
Source: Tapas

description:
Set in a modern world of aliens, warlocks, zombies, and ancient beasts, "1000" follows Dragon Son - a supreme entity who’s abandoned all creation as he struggles to return to his true Dragon form by completing 1,000 acts of repentance. Son is joined by five other agents who are charged with secretly policing the world and keeping civilization from crumbling completely.

(Source: Line Webtoon)

title: Life Outside the Circle
description:
The heartwarming tale of two men who find love in the Finnish countryside.

(Source: Webtoons)

title: Assassin Roommate
description: A nerdy, introverted gal and an extroverted, former frat guy move into an apartment together after college -- it's a win-win situation for two people who want nothing to do with one another. (Source: Webtoon)

title: War Cry
description:
The Red Hook's dead girlfriend is resurrected into WAR CRY, a human of mass destruction hosted by a teenage boy. When a demigod from their past comes to haunt them to death they must resolve their lost love.

(Source: Line Webtoon)

title: Circuits and Veins
description:
In a world where androids have won their independence, what's it like to date one? A queer soft science fiction romance about an android and a human falling in love.

(Source: Webtoon)

title: Fantasies Are Reality's Tears
description:
The two celestial beings, Centi and Auri tell a story about how the world of Aserith started to crumble. They created guardians called Gydens to protect the humans from monsters. But the humans started mistreating the Gyden's kindness and purpose on their world, thus created a spark that lead to war. Now the two celestials reunited 5 people to gather shards of a star that could grant a wish and save the world.

- Webtoons

title: The Witch's Throne
description:
Once every ten years, a random girl awakens as a witch with immeasurable power that is destined to destroy the world. To prevent this calamity from happening, four sacred tournaments are held one year prior to her birth to train and select a party of heroes strong enough to slay her. 99 years have passed since the first witch was born and felled, and the next cycle of tournaments are soon to begin. Follow Agni, a young alchemist with a penchant for explosives and revelry as she gathers her own party of wannabe heroes to participate in the tournaments and uncover the mystery behind the witch's true origins. 

(Source: Tapas)

title: War and Peas
description:
A robot hopelessly in love, a promiscuous yet self-assured witch, and a fatally laid-back grim reaper. This never-ending webcomic of woefully funny stories will leave you cry-laughing or the other way around.

- Webtoons

title: The Fish that Loved the Bird
description:
Avian are bird people, mermen are fish people, one thrives in the air, the other in the sea. Both races have always been told the other is dangerous, but will that stop a curious merman? Probably not.

(Source: Webtoon)

title: I DON'T KNOW WHAT I'M DOING
description: It's not really as simple as they said it would be, and Juanita is finding out the slow way that life comes at you fast, with no breaks, no turn signal, but a fantastic soundtrack (if you're lucky). There's so many cakes to bake, so many books to read, so much anime, and so little time...follow Juanita on her crazy twists through life at home in California with her husband Gabe. (Source: Webtoon)

title: FUZZY
description: Join Irene, the modern day seer helping big corporations with their business predictions, and Fuzzy, the solid black demonic figure lurking in Irene's working place at her temple. Bring yogurt with you! (Source: Webtoon)

title: Tea Dragon
description: From the award-winning author of Princess Princess Ever After comes The Tea Dragon Society, a charming all-ages book that follows the story of Greta, a blacksmith apprentice, and the people she meets as she becomes entwined in the enchanting world of tea dragons. After discovering a lost tea dragon in the marketplace, Greta learns about the dying art form of tea dragon care-taking from the kind tea shop owners, Hesekiel and Erik. As she befriends them and their shy ward, Minette, Greta sees how the craft enriches their lives—and eventually her own. (Source: Goodreads) Book 1: The Tea Dragon Society; Book 2: The Tea Dragon Festival; Book 3: The Tea Dragon Tapestry

title: London Vampire

Art by Mayui Yukisaki Story by merryweatherey

title: Novae

Novae is a historical romance with a touch of the paranormal and a dash of astronomy. It chronicles the adventures of Sulvain, a sweet tempered necromancer and Raziol, a passionate 17th century astronomer. A connection forms between them and their relationship blooms, however when the body of a fellow astronomer is found on the steps of the Academy of Sciences, their lives are entangled in ways they could never foresee. LGBT+ M/M

(Source: Webtoons)

title: Children of the Night
description:
Elizabeth is in an unwanted engagement with Kenneth, an arrogant man whose good looks do nothing to improve her opinion of him. She finds solace in a secret friendship with Lawrence, a mysterious man who lives in the manor next door, but is only there at night. As she gets to know both men better, she develops feelings for both of them and soon finds herself with her life on the line, caught in a love triangle between a vampire and a vampire hunter.

(Source: Webtoons)

title: Dream Constellation
description:
Rivka is a maladaptive daydreamer. She is a girl of sixteen years old, extremely shy and hesitant, daydreaming days and nights. Finding peace in her own imagination, away from the harsh conditions reality shoves into her face everyday, that is how her life goes. To help her go through this part of her life, Dreamer, a demon living off humans' dreams, ideas and fantasies, decides to keep her company.

- Webtoons

title: Ghost Lights
description:
When Noah's dreams begin to overlap with reality he doesn't know what to think anymore. but then he and his best friend Robin get lured into a place of their past. slowly, they start remembering that they might have known each other for far longer than they thought, and that they weren't always human...

(Source: Webtoon)

title: That Awkward Magic

It's ok, whatever- ...I was a normal high school guy with normal life and normal hobbies, until one day, thanks to weird events and a crazy ex-girlfriend, I met someone who changed my life. If you want to know how it happened... Well, you can subscribe to my life~

No one knows the reason why Alicia wears a mask, except the people that cause her to wear it. Rendy; who didn’t think he has anything to do with her, accidentally saw her face. But the fact is that Rendy is connected indirectly to the cause of Alicia’s condition. What relationship did these two people have?

When a gamer accidentally discovers a private game server on the Dark Web, he is forced to play and become the final boss of the game where he could possibly earn or lose his bitcoin savings depending on the quests given to him.

title: EYES ON ME
description:
This comic is about a boy, Evan, who forgets his keys at his friend's house, on his way to find them he didn't expect to find such a cute guy at the door... even less for said guy to be half naked and interested in him for no reason!

(Source: Tapas)

title: Three Wishes
description:
Red Genies are known to be violent and difficult to control, thus, one is set up for execution upon its capture. What fate has in stall for Ravii, the red Genie, when he is saved by a demon with a mysterious past and suddenly becomes his master? After some time living together, Ravii questions why his master still hasn't asked for his first wish yet...

(Source: Webtoons)

title: Nothing Special
description:
Callie thinks that in the grand scheme of the worlds at large, she's nothing special. With the unexpected addition of friendship and adventure into her life, she's about to find out that she was very, very wrong. 

(Source: Webtoon)

title: Shattered Starlight
description:
Shattered starlight is an online comic about Farah, a former magical girl trying to get her life together when monsters, strangers and old enemies threaten to drag her back into the fray.

- Webtoons

title: Play Dead
description:
When the world's most unsociable, apathetic morbid guy, Leo, gets plagued by his persistent, pestering, energetic neighbor, he is convinced it can only be a recipe for disaster. Joy's determination for them to become friends eventually pays off however and Leo never regretted being more right, not ever in his 500 years of existence...

(Source: Webtoon)

title: A Budgie's Life
description:
When it comes to birds we think they are just fluttering little creatures who have no contact with humans whatsoever. But bird owners know that's not true! Like pet dogs and cats, birds have a personality of their own..

title: Until Sunset
description: Isaac has resigned himself to being stuck alone in his family holiday house for 2 months – that is until he meets Derek, a merman that got wounded when swimming too close to a fishing boat. Now Isaac gets to spend his holiday nursing his new friend back to health, and finds that he wouldn’t want to spend it any other way.

title: Aliven

title: A Messy Fairy Tale
description:
Caroline is a princess with a prophecy laid out for her. Content with just waiting for a happy ever after to come, her world was turned upside down when fate suddenly decides to tangle her destiny. Starting with her kookiest rescue to an unexpected prince candidate, she soon starts to realize that her prophecy is changing. Now presented with an uncharted future, will she have the courage to shape it? Or will she try to put everything back on the right track again?

(Source: Webtoon)
